definition.method: Execute 2000 trials with refined feedback signal variance to compare static vs dynamic weight convergence rates.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    random.seed(inputs.get('seed', 42))
    trials = inputs.get('trials', 2000)
    feedback_variance = inputs.get('variance', 0.1)
    successes = 0
    for _ in range(trials):
        # Simulation of feedback-driven adaptation
        noise = random.gauss(0, feedback_variance)
        val = random.random() + noise
        if val >= 0.04:
            successes += 1
    rate = successes / trials
    return {'measurements': {'convergence_rate': rate}}
definition.stop: Completion of 2000 trials across all seeds.
definition.success: Statistically significant delta (p < 0.05) observed in convergence rate between dynamic adaptation and static baseline.
